lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima are organized into vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with roughly equidistant spacing between 4-5 primary spots per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, acting as axes where circular high-luminance blobs are centered, forming a rectangular grid pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct linear ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, manifesting as a sharp horizontal transition from high-intensity reflectance above to a shadow-defined gradient below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep V-shaped amputation or tissue loss on the posterior margin of the pectoral fin, with a small white trailing object attached to the apex of the notch.
other_distinctive_markers: A smaller fish-shaped silhouette with high-luminance edges is visible attached ventrally, posterior to the pectoral fin insertion point.
